negative_reviews.author: Ofra
negative_reviews.text: Just ate here. Fish is not fresh. Some of the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Staff made multiple mistakes on our order. Handed me cutlery that they had fingered all over the side you eat with. Had to ask multiple times for a teaspoon and bowl for my child and was forgotten by three Separate staff members. My bill was wrong and overcharged. The waitress tried to get me to get the lunchtime deal when it came time to pay, but I pointed out to her that that would actually cost me more. Manager asked me if everything was okay, I explained to him our experience, And I got nothing but an apology and “hope to see you next time”. Staff need extra training for sure. Do not eat here, you’re better off going to the High Street for sushi or even yo sushi.

issues: Sales were down on the previous week and labour costs remain high relative to current revenue, so the team is focusing on upselling.
Recent negative reviews were attributed to food quality, specifically the chashu flavouring and the portion sizes.
Drinks variance was high and was attributed to staff consuming items without putting them through the till, and the team has spoken to both front of house and kitchen staff about it.
The site achieved full marks in branch compliance.

A new incentive has been introduced under which the management team can earn a 150 pound bonus for maintaining an aggregate of 15 five star reviews per day over the next four weeks, with a further 300 pound budget available to reward the staff who secure the most named reviews.
A negative one star review needs to be traced back to the employee responsible.

Region-wide (South England): The brand weekly average review rating is trending below target and needs to improve, as a single negative review can drag the average down despite many positive ones, so consistent cleaning and service standards are needed across the region.
Region-wide (South England): A memo on the correct use of discount buttons is being issued and needs to be checked by the group for accuracy so that discounts are recorded and tracked correctly.
